correctness.rationale: For each integer \(m\ge2\) and real \(t>0\), the tree polynomial of \(K_{2,m}\) with path-wise equal conductances is established by exhaustive structural tree classification. Differentiating it yields exact resistances, verified to equal \(1\) or \(t^2\) with the positive quadratic root. All multipliers remain strictly positive. Log-determinant concavity provides a global certificate for the unique centered John ellipsoid; central symmetry then yields global uniqueness among all translated ellipsoids. The intrinsic volume follows from the matrix-tree theorem. The fixed-t, fixed-m small-t, and critical \(t=c/\sqrt m\) limits follow from explicit quadratic-root and log-ratio expansions. Independent symbolic grounded-Laplacian and numerical full-matrix checks reproduce the finite specializations; finite checks are not the infinite proof.
